hotspots.title: Jair Bolsonaro Hospitalized with Severe Intestinal Obstruction
hotspots.blurb: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro remains in intensive care at a Brasilia hospital following acute intestinal obstruction. His medical crisis has triggered widespread prayer vigils from supporters while his son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, aggressively accuses the judiciary and political system of electoral persecution.
hotspots.affect: Acute health anxiety for the movement's leader blends with intense grievances against the judicial system to create a high-stakes martyr narrative.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: In the final stretch toward regional and general election polls, Vox leadership has doubled down on hardline platform demands including mass remigration, national priority for services, and dismantling Spain's autonomous state system. The party faces intense counter-protests while locked in fierce rivalries with both the PP and PSOE.
hotspots.affect: High affective investment is driven by zero-sum existential campaign rhetoric surrounding Spanish national identity and migration policy.

hotspots.title: AfD Escalates Deportation Demands at Party Congresses
hotspots.blurb: AfD state congresses in North Rhine-Westphalia and Thuringia featured fierce rhetoric demanding an aggressive 'deportation offensive' targeting millions of foreigners, including Ukrainian refugees. The party's hardline stance coincides with sharp internal factional infighting and escalating calls from opponents for a formal party ban.
hotspots.affect: The convergence of radical policy demands, internal party warfare, and public outrage creates a charged debate over democratic norms and state security.

hotspots.title: RN Headquarters Raided in State Leaks Probe
hotspots.blurb: French prosecutors are investigating confidential Interior Ministry documents allegedly discovered in the circle of Rassemblement National leader Marine Le Pen. Le Pen has mounted a vigorous media defense denying any knowledge or receipt of classified leaks, while political rivals seize on the scandal ahead of the 2027 presidential race.
hotspots.affect: Allegations of state intelligence leaks touch directly on institutional integrity and produce intense defensiveness from RN leadership.

hotspots.title: Milei Battles Internal Feuds over PASO Primary Suspension
hotspots.blurb: Javier Milei's administration is pushing to suspend Argentina's compulsory PASO primary elections, facing heavy pushback from both opposition lawmakers and coalition allies. Meanwhile, internal tension rises inside La Libertad Avanza as Presidential Secretary Karina Milei consolidates power amid warnings over economic debt risks.
hotspots.affect: Fears over electoral manipulation combined with internal power struggles generate significant political friction and institutional urgency.
